## Overview

LRPGF04m is the **explicitly associational treatment-moderation variant** of
LRPGF04 (#391 finding 3 decision, 2026-07-22): the same gain-factors model for
letter sounds (L) with the pre-specified treatment interactions
(on-intervention $\times$ ability, on-intervention $\times$ own baseline)
that the interaction-free causal headline dropped.

_No causal headline here._ The moderation terms are estimated on **all** stacked
period transitions — including post-crossover rows with no untreated comparison —
so the interaction-aware period-1 marginal (the on-intervention contrast with the
fitted interactions netted out) is model-dependent and partly informed by
post-crossover data. Every number in this report, the netted treatment contrast
included, is an **adjusted association**; read the randomised effect from
LRPGF04. Moderation on roughly 25 period-1 control children is not seriously
estimable in any case — these posteriors bound the moderation questions rather
than settle them. The robustness release gate skips this fit for exactly that
reason (the gated causal headline lives in LRPGF04).

## Model

The linear predictor is LRPGF04's (see that report for the full formula and
adjustment-set rationale) plus the two treatment-interaction terms:

$$
\ldots + \gamma_{\text{int:trt}\times\text{ability}}\,
(\text{trt} \times z(\text{blocks}))
 + \gamma_{\text{int:trt}\times\text{own}}\,
(\text{trt} \times z(\operatorname{logit}_*(\text{own}_{\text{pre}}))),
$$

with the same likelihood, priors and non-centred child random intercept as
LRPGF04. The reported treatment contrast nets both interactions out of
`beta_trt` per draw (#391 finding 1), and its direction, intervals and ROPE
classification all come from those same netted draws.
